latHint: Think invisible, high-energy rays from exploding stars.
pivHint: A DELTA is the fan-shaped land where a river meets the sea. It is also the fourth letter of an old alphabet that begins alpha, beta, ______.
winText: Right on the letter. DELTA was the pivot - a river's fan of land to the letter just before it, GAMMA.
lossText: GAMMA - the third letter of an old alphabet that runs alpha, beta, GAMMA, DELTA. DELTA was the pivot: a river DELTA is where land fans out at the sea, but DELTA is also a letter, and GAMMA comes right before it.
